subject: Sprint gap scan: launch owners & OKR check
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint gap scan: launch owners & OKR check

Team —

As we sprint toward the May pilot, I need a quick gap scan across GTM, enablement, pricing, docs, and support readiness. This is a focused leadership check to call out any blockers that could cause an OKR miss or QBR escalation. 

Can each of you respond by EOD today with: 
- 1–2 current gaps you own (concise)
- 1 committed mitigation or owner if you do not own it
- ETA to close (date) and whether closure is a hard dependency for launch

I attached a lightweight gap worksheet to capture answers — please update the row that matches your area and keep notes short. We will synthesize and I’ll pull a short slide for Monday’s QBR prep.

Quick asks by area: 
- Marissa (GTM): demo cadence, pilot enrollments, runbook for dark launches
- Laura (Enablement): training readiness, onboarding doc completion, enablement hours booked
- Marcus (Pricing): final price sheet, bundling options, discount guardrails
- Monica (Support): support runbook and escalation paths

Cc’ing Lisa Grant from Acme (partner) so they’re aware of any partner-facing items; contracts@acme.com for any procurement dependencies.

Thanks — keep it tight.

Diego Fernandez
VP, Launch & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_launch_gap_scan_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, Lisa Grant <lisa@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint gap scan: launch owners & OKR check

Diego —

Quick update from GTM: 
- Gap 1: Demo environment parity — last-minute model variant differences between staging and pilot infra causing inconsistent latency numbers.
  - Owner: Marissa Cole (GTM) / infra ping to runtime team (cc’d separately)
  - Mitigation: Lock model variant for pilot, white-list canary hosts, and run 2 smoke rounds by 4/22.
  - ETA: 2027-04-22 (hard dependency for public pilot)

- Gap 2: Enrollment funnel clarity — pilot sign-up form missing SSO option needed by Acme.
  - Owner: Marissa Cole (GTM) + Lisa Grant (Acme) for requirements
  - Mitigation: Temporary manual onboarding flow and a documented SSO requirement; full SSO path targeted later.
  - ETA: manual onboarding by 4/25 (not blocking pilot start but impacts partner experience)

Also attached the pilot playbook excerpt (link in Drive). I’ll add rows to the attached gap worksheet.

Marissa
Director, Growth Marketing — Redwood
[Attachment: pilot_playbook_excerpt.pdf (pdf)]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, Lisa Grant <lisa@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint gap scan: launch owners & OKR check

Diego / team —

Enablement status: 
- Gap: Training deck is at 90% — missing two customer-specific flows and a short quiz for success criteria.
  - Owner: Laura Bennett (Enablement)
  - Mitigation: Publish v1.0 to the partner portal and push the customer-specific slides as an addendum. Quick quiz will be a lightweight checklist instead of a full assessment.
  - ETA: 2027-04-21 (soft dependency; pilot can run with v1.0 but onboarding effectiveness will be affected)

- Gap: Internal playbook for tier-1 support reps (first-touch troubleshooting) is incomplete.
  - Owner: Monica Patel (Support Ops) — Monica, can you confirm if you want this one? If yes, we’ll schedule a joint session on Tuesday.

Note: I uploaded the current deck to Drive and attached a PDF export for offline review.

Laura Bennett
Head of Enablement
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: enablement-training-deck-v0.9.pdf (pdf)]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint gap scan: launch owners & OKR check

Diego — short pricing note: 
- Gap: Final bundle and pilot discount cap not signed off. Current ask from Acme is a 20% pilot discount; guardrails in our playbook currently cap pilot discounts at 15% without CRO approval.
  - Owner: Marcus Lin (Pricing) / Diego for escalation to CRO if needed
  - Mitigation: Offer 15% pilot discount + $50k credit on overage protection (structured credit, non-refundable) — qualifies within existing guardrails and gives Acme runway to evaluate.
  - ETA: Need approval by 2027-04-20 to get contracting started; otherwise deal may slip.

I attached the pricing worksheet with modeled ARR impact under both options.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Strategy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing-final-worksheet.xlsx (xlsx)]

On Mon, Apr 18, 2027 at 13:40 Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Laura / team —
> 
> Thanks — please confirm the support playbook owner.
> 
> Diego
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Lisa Grant <lisa@acme.com>, contracts@acme.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint gap scan: launch owners & OKR check — consolidated owners & next steps

Appreciate the quick updates. Consolidating and calling owners: 

- Demo parity / infra smoke tests — Marissa (ETA 4/22) — Marissa, ping runtime infra and loop infra leads; keep me posted if smoke fails. (Hard dependency)
- Pilot enrollment SSO gap — Marissa + Lisa (Acme) (Manual onboarding by 4/25; SSO backlog)
- Training deck publish (v1.0) — Laura (ETA 4/21) — publish to partner portal; add addendum for Acme flows. (Soft dependency)
- Support tier-1 playbook — Monica (Confirm ownership; propose joint session Tue 4/20).
- Pricing guardrail / pilot discount — Marcus (Action: offer 15% + $50k overage credit). Marcus, I’ll escalate to CRO if you need above-guardrail approval — please share modeled impact by EOD Tue 4/20. (Contract milestone)

Next steps: 
- Everyone: update the attached redwood_launch_gap_scan_v1.xlsx by EOD Monday 4/19 with final ETA and status. I will produce a 1-slide summary and share with execs Monday AM.
- Marissa: schedule a 30-min cross-functional sync for Tuesday (propose 10:00am PT).
- Marcus: confirm pricing path and whether I need to escalate.

If there are any last-minute blockers that are likely to move the ETA, call them out in the spreadsheet and ping me directly.

Diego Fernandez
VP, Launch & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_launch_gap_scan_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
